title: 第9章 中州柳家第10章 三年之约
content_zh:
孤傲潇洒的冲天剑意萦绕在叶祈安周身，剑气肆意激荡，将周围竹林切割成碎片。
白裙女子见状美眸轻挑，惊讶的看着变了一个人的叶祈安。
“你...不是他，实力竟一跃而至四个大境界。”
“你就真不怕他这副孱弱的身体撑不住这么庞大的力量么？”
叶祈安从腰间拿出酒壶猛灌一口，飒然一笑。
“哈哈哈，爽！多少年了，终于是再次尝到一口酒的滋味了。”
随后放荡不羁的大笑一声，剑指白裙女子。
“小女娃，别废话，要打就打，不打的话老夫可就离开了。”
“嗝~”
白裙女子似乎也是被激到了，娇躯元力不断震荡，天青色的元力疯狂涌动。
庞大的元气威压将整个竹林席卷，一度蔓延至凶兽山脉深处，让众多凶兽瑟瑟发抖。
“那我倒要看看你这老家伙到底有几分真本事....”
话音落下，白裙女子率先发起进攻，手中凝聚天青色元气射杀向叶祈安。
看着女子轰杀而来的元气杀招，叶祈安并没有慌张，反而是隐隐有兴奋激动的意思。
叶祈安手持归尘剑，瞬间进入了人剑合一的境界，仿佛就是配合多年的默契老友一般。
身影一闪，便轻松躲开了白裙女子的一击。
一抹青光乍现，白裙女子瞬间出现在叶祈安身前蓄势一掌轰出。
“砰！”
叶祈安操控归尘剑迅速反应过来横挡，便将这一掌化解掉。
但身影还是被击退了数十米，在湿润的地面上划出两道深深的足迹。

叶祈安挥了挥尘土，懒洋洋的掏耳朵说道：“小女娃，我道以为是多大口气，原来就这？”
这一轻浮不屑的表情让白裙女子面纱下的俏脸一凝，银牙紧咬。
“找死。”
经过和叶祈安几个回合的试探，她明白如果不使出全力恐怕拿不下这少年。
这必定不是少年原来的实力，想来应该是寄托在他体内的某种强大神魂。
能让淬体境爆发出堪比造气境的强横实力，这道神魂生前也必定是个恐怖的存在。
但那又如何，今天她势必要为自家大黄报仇。
挥出一道元气形成结界将竹苑这方天地气息屏蔽。
只见她纤细白皙的手指上的纳戒浮现出一阵耀眼的光芒，一把天青色，长七寸的笛子握在手中，顿时一股强横的神魂威压如同潮水般杀向叶祈安。
叶祈安见状眉头紧皱，盯着那七寸长笛，似是有些熟悉。
“这是...”
“镇魂笛!”
闻言，白裙女子美眸中闪过一丝惊讶。
“你竟认得此笛？”
叶祈安冷哼一声，似乎是有些较量的味道。
“哼，我道以为这如此偏僻之地怎会出现你这等妖孽的小女娃，原来是中州柳家之人。”
“何止是认得，镇魂笛，天元大陆十大灵器榜排名第三。”
“天阶高级灵器，笛音神鬼莫测，专克神魂，杀气冲天，小女娃，看来你的身份不简单啊，那柳天行竟舍得将这镇族神器交给你。”
叶祈安脸色升起一抹凝重。
有点麻烦了，若是这小女娃再配合她家族祖传功法悲鸣镇魂曲就有点够呛了。
content_en:
The arrogant and unrestrained soaring sword spirit lingered around Ye Qi'an, and the sword spirit surged wantonly, cutting the surrounding bamboo forest into pieces.
The woman in the white dress raised her beautiful eyes slightly when she saw this, and looked at Ye Qian'an who had changed in surprise.
"You... are not him, but your strength has jumped to four realms."
"Aren't you really afraid that his weak body won't be able to support such a huge force?"
Ye Qi'an took out the wine bottle from his waist and took a sip, smiling sarcastically.
"Hahaha, it feels so good! After so many years, I finally have a taste of wine again."
Then he laughed wildly and pointed his sword at the woman in the white dress.
"Little girl, don't talk nonsense. If you want to fight, then fight. If you don't, I will leave."
"Hiccup~"
The woman in the white dress seemed to be aroused, her delicate body was constantly vibrating, and her azure energy was surging crazily.
The huge vitality pressure swept through the entire bamboo forest, and once spread to the depths of the Ferocious Beast Mountain Range, making many ferocious beasts tremble.
"Then I want to see what real abilities you, old guy, have..."
After the words fell, the woman in the white dress took the lead in attacking, condensing azure energy in her hand and shooting at Ye Qian.
Seeing the woman's vitality killing move, Ye Qi'an did not panic, but felt faintly excited.
Ye Qian held the Guichen Sword in his hand and instantly entered the realm of the unity of man and sword, as if he were an old friend who had been working together for many years.
The figure flashed and easily dodged the attack of the woman in the white dress.
A flash of blue light suddenly appeared, and the woman in the white dress instantly appeared in front of Ye Qi'an, preparing to strike out with a palm.
"Bang!"
Ye Qian controlled Guichen Sword to react quickly and block the attack, then neutralized the palm.
But the figure was still pushed back dozens of meters, leaving two deep footprints on the wet ground.
Ye Qi'an waved the dust, lazily picked out his ears and said, "Little girl, how loud do you think you are, is this all?"
This frivolous and disdainful expression made the pretty face of the woman in the white dress freeze under her veil, and she clenched her silver teeth.
"Seeking death."
After several rounds of testing with Ye Qian, she understood that she might not be able to defeat the boy if she didn't use her full strength.
This must not be the young man's original strength. It must be some kind of powerful soul entrusted in his body.
It can make the body-tempering realm explode with tyrannical strength comparable to that of the Qi-making realm. This divine soul must have been a terrifying existence during its lifetime.
But so what, today she must avenge her own rhubarb.
He waved out a line of vitality to form a barrier to shield the aura of heaven and earth in Zhuyuan.
A dazzling light appeared on the ring on her slender white fingers. She held a seven-inch long azure flute in her hand. Suddenly, a tyrannical pressure from the soul rushed towards Ye Qian like a tide.
Ye Qian'an frowned upon seeing this and stared at the seven-inch flute, which seemed familiar.
"This is..."
"Soul Flute!"
Hearing this, a trace of surprise flashed in the beautiful eyes of the woman in the white dress.
"You actually recognize this flute?"
Ye Qi'an snorted coldly, seeming to be a bit competitive.
"Hmph, I thought how could a monster like you appear in such a remote place. It turns out she is a member of the Liu family in Zhongzhou."
"More than just recognizing it, the soul-suppressing flute ranks third on the list of the top ten spiritual weapons in Tianyuan Continent."
"Heaven-level high-level spiritual weapon, the sound of the flute is unpredictable, it can control the souls, and its murderous intent is so high. Little girl, it seems that your identity is not simple. That Liu Tianxing is willing to hand over this clan-killing artifact to you."
Ye Qian's face became solemn.
It's a bit troublesome. It would be a bit annoying if this little girl sang a requiem in conjunction with her family's ancestral skills.
